ringchart.description: Display independent progress as concentric rings.
ringchart.contract: Each ring uses its own value/maxValue and keeps input order from inside to outside. Invalid values and non-positive maxima are omitted. Values exceeding a target render a full ring while summaries retain the actual value. Defaults: 12px width, 6px gap and 60px base inner radius, scaled down to fit. Angles use radians. animationDuration defaults to 1100ms; enterTransition takes precedence. geometryScrubbing skips path animation while preserving each Ring’s color, caps and hover behavior.
ringchart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect rings, Escape or blur clears the highlight. Reduced motion skips decorative animation. RingCenter custom rendering runs for both total and hovered values; the default data object contains aggregate value and maximum.
ringchart.compatibility: Use Ring and RingCenter inside RingChart. Shared legends come from chart-core. RingChart shows independent progress; use PieChart with innerRadius for parts of one total.
